global._proxy: derived: copy of north_america (all ladder inputs are US Carta/PitchBook/Crunchbase data; no global cohort study captured)

_baseline.median_months_to_next: 2025 Carta US software (seed->A 26.4 mo, A->B 32.4 mo)
_baseline.valuation: 2025 Carta medians (seed pre $16M, A pre $49.3M, B pre $118.9M)

prob_raise_next.note: derived: CB Insights 2008-2010 seed cohort 46% raised a 2nd round (https://www.cbinsights.com/research/venture-capital-funnel-2/) / 0.50 baseline; Crunchbase 2011-2018: >1 in 2 reach A (https://news.crunchbase.com/liquidity/seed-funding-series-a-success/)

valuation_seed.note: derived: PitchBook 2016 seed pre $5.0M (via JPMorgan) / PitchBook 2025 $16.0M (SaaStr citing PitchBook) - same-vendor ratio
derived: Carta Q2 2019 median seed $8M / $16M (https://carta.com/data/state-of-private-markets-q1-2025/). PitchBook series gives 0.375 (2018 $6.0M / 2025 $16.0M).

prob_seed_to_A.note: derived: mean 2-yr rate of 2020Q3 (~40%) and 2021Q1 (32.9%) Carta cohorts / normal mean 31.6%

prob_A_to_B.note: derived: 2020 Series A cohort 40.8% within 2 yrs / 2018 cohort ~26% (https://carta.com/data/linkedin-series-a-to-series-b-harder-now/)

valuation_A.note: derived: Carta 2021 Series A ~$40.6M (implied by 2026 $63.3M = +56% vs 2021) / $49.3M

valuation_late_D_plus.note: derived: Carta 2021 Series D median pre $727.8M / 2026 $534.3M - late-stage 2021 valuations still exceed today's

prob_seed_to_A.note: derived: mean of 2022Q1 (15.4%) and 2022 full-year (~17%) 2-yr rates / 31.6%

prob_A_to_B.note: derived: 2022 Series A cohort 15.1% within 2 yrs / ~26% (2022Q3 cohort only 9% -> 0.35)

months_seed_to_A.note: derived: Q4 2024 774 days (25.4 mo) / 26.4 - waits peaked in late 2024 as crunch cohorts finally raised

shutdown.note: derived: Carta shutdowns 966 (2024) / 769 (2023); Q1 2023->Q1 2024 seed closures +102% (https://carta.com/data/startup-shutdowns-q1-2024/)

prob_seed_to_A.note: derived, low confidence: Carta 1-yr seed->A for 2024-25 cohorts (9-13%) is back at 2021Q3 levels (~1.0) while Crunchbase 2026 says odds of reaching A 'fall dramatically' for the 2024 cohort (~0.5); midpoint

ai_premium.note: AI Series A pre-money premium 2025 (Carta); apply via sector_modifiers for ai_ml ideas only. Seed 1.42x, B 1.50x (2024).

shutdown.note: Mixed: SimpleClosure saw 2.6x more closures in Q1 2026 vs Q1 2025 (one provider; https://news.crunchbase.com/startups/salvaging-shutdowns-simpleclosure-dori-yona-qa); no Carta 2025 total captured
